---
title: "Next and Recommendation"
author: "Yun Jiang"
---

## next

1. M: ecsngsqc migration to sam-tagger must target 0.8.0: drop the
   `amplification_primer_*_seq` columns from the generated config (rename to
   `amp_primer_*` in the same change) and pass `--fasta` to the AP rules (S31
   annotate + any qc-summary call).
2. M: wps_1012 adopts v0.8.x (env pin): add error-stats `--fasta` and AP-rule
   `--fasta`, migrate qc-summary `_pct` column reads to `_rate`, and switch the
   S37_1 explicit-flags workaround to `--prefix`.

## recommendation

1. H: ecsngsqc: drop or repair the 27 misplaced R1 records (fwd, POS 1,
   NM>=20, AS~len — e.g. at S23) — they manufacture the N-heavy error
   profile reported as mismatches.
2. M: report the bwa-mem2 placement defect upstream with the local repro
   recipe (fwd read, true window at ref pos 2-4 -> POS 1 + wrong MD/NM +
   kept AS; scripts in /tmp/samtagger_debug/).
3. M: add a `to_n` column (or N split) to error.parquet so pairloom-
   unresolved N calls stay separable from true substitutions.
4. M: submit sam-tagger 0.8.0 to bioconda — recipes/sam-tagger/meta.yaml is
   updated with the v0.8.0 sha256; use the upload-to-bioconda skill.
5. L: on future releases, expect the release workflow to auto-create the
   GitHub release on tag push — use `gh release edit` for curated notes
   instead of `create`.
6. L: run `ruff format` on changed files only — the repo is not format-clean
   under the current ruff, and blanket runs rewrite unrelated files.
